键盘检查：按 Tab 移动到按钮，确认焦点环清晰；按 Enter 或空格执行操作: Keyboard check: Tab to a button and verify the focus ring. Press Enter or Space to activate it.
统一设计规范，管理交付进度与反馈。: Maintain shared design guidelines and manage delivery progress and feedback.
让好设计成为日常。: Make good design part of every day.
我们把字体放到真实段落中。清晰的层级、舒适的阅读节奏和合适的留白，是产品体验的一: Typography belongs in real paragraphs. Clear hierarchy, readable rhythm and thoughtful spacing shape the experience.

连接中断，请检查后重试。: Connection lost. Check it and try again.
辅助说明与不可用状态也需要足够清晰。: Help text and unavailable states must also remain clear.
按钮、表单、图表与卡片使用同一套语义变量。: Buttons, forms, charts and cards share the same semantic tokens.
示例界面 · 用于检查主题，不会提交业务数据: Sample interface · For theme checks; no business data is submitted
未能连接：请检查桥接脚本、允许来源和页面嵌入策略。: Connection failed. Check the bridge script, allowed origins and embedding policy.
请输入不含凭据的 HTTP(S) 预览地址: Enter an HTTP(S) preview URL without credentials.
仅用于你控制的开发预览。安装脚本后，将 data-studio-origin 设: For development previews you control. Install the script and set data-studio-origin to this Studio origin. The page must allow embedding by that origin.
主题变量决定颜色与尺寸。品牌用法、组件状态、页面任务需要独立检查。: Tokens define colors and sizes. Brand usage, component states and page tasks need separate checks.
中性暖灰与细边框，墨色主操作。橙色只用于少量强调；中英文无衬线。: Warm neutrals, fine borders and ink primary actions. Orange is a sparse accent; Chinese and English use sans-serif type.
默认、键盘焦点、加载、禁用、空态与错误都要可读，并提供下一步。: Default, focus, loading, disabled, empty and error states must be readable and offer a next step.
说明动作结果、失败原因和恢复方式。设计修改进入版本审核，不直接覆盖规范。: Explain outcomes, failure reasons and recovery. Design changes go through review before replacing standards.
已执行的自动检查未发现偏离: No deviations found in the automated checks
标志是否正确、橙色使用面积、页面是否有多个主操作、真实任务是否顺畅，不能由 to: Token values cannot verify the logo, orange coverage, primary action hierarchy or real workflows. These remain unverified; no Experience Score is generated.
还没有导入项目品牌与组件规范。请在「审核变更」中载入现有 Foundation，: No project brand or component rules imported. Load the existing Foundation in Review changes before treating a theme preset as a complete design system.
透明色需要结合实际背景检查: Check transparent colors against the actual background.
文字对比度检查（不是完整无障碍审计）: Text contrast check (not a full accessibility audit)
主按钮使用墨色 / 近白；暖橙用于少量强调，不用作按钮底色。: Use ink / near-white primary buttons. Reserve orange for sparse accents, not button backgrounds.
苹方优先，并保留平台备用字体。实际字体取决于设备安装情况。: Prefer PingFang with platform fallbacks. The rendered font depends on installed fonts.
用户字体要求（覆盖品牌书的衬线标题规则）: User font requirement (overrides serif brand headings)
品牌规范不使用卡片阴影；浮层可单独使用浮层阴影。: Brand rules avoid card shadows. Floating surfaces may use their own shadows.
细节决定质感。: Details shape how a product feels.
